title: [WHT]-Withholding Tax is not deducted from Expense Report lines based on the Expense Category during posting
summary: Withholding tax is now correctly calculated and deducted from expense report lines based on the assigned expense category during posting.
key_points: Added withholding tax support for expense reports through category-based rules
Created new buffer table and posting handler for expense withholding tax processing
Extended general journal posting logic to apply withholding tax deductions
Added new permission set for expense withholding tax functionality
Fixed calculation logic for employee withholding tax transactions
